Overview

Prilep is a city in Pelagonia with a population of 66,000. A city in southern North Macedonia known as the ‘City of Tobacco’ for its tobacco production, the Marko’s Towers fortress, and the Treskavec Monastery. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
